note: DRAFT. Fields and token-budget semantics must be coordinated with Workstream B (repair/sandbox/certificate owner) before any implementation. Implementation of src/tracefix/retrieval/manifest.py is blocked until this contract is finalized.

context_manifest.revision: full git SHA of the snapshot the context was retrieved from
context_manifest.strategy_config: serializable; every strategy that contributed items and its configuration

totals.tokens: int; sum of item token contributions as computed by the configured tokenizer
totals.duplicates: int; items referring to the same evidence target that were merged or dropped

evidence_item.evidence_id: string; stable within the run; must equal the evidence_id from the ranked item that produced it
evidence_item.evidence_type: e.g. function_body, file_header, signature, commit, test, graph_path
evidence_item.strategy: string; retrieval strategy that produced it
evidence_item.graph_path: optional; node/edge sequence explaining graph expansion
evidence_item.expansion_explanation: optional; human-readable reason the graph expansion reached this item
evidence_item.selection_reason: why the context selector kept it (e.g. top-ranked, budget-filler, diversity-spread)
evidence_item.token_contribution: int; tokens this item added to the package

token_accounting.interface: configurable tokenizer (Checkpoint 0 D4: approved with condition)

config.name: string; e.g. tiktoken
config.encoding: e.g. cl100k_base when tiktoken is used; null for heuristic estimators
config.method: tiktoken | char_div_4 | other (must name the actual implementation)

token_accounting.rule: Every token figure is either measured with a named tokenizer or labeled estimated:true with its method. Bare unlabeled token numbers are contract violations. tiktoken may be used only if compatible with the selected model; the encoding must be recorded.

bound_rules: items[] is serializable JSON and round-trips without loss of contract fields
every item declares provenance and source
no item may reference a file path or line range that was not present at manifest.revision

handoff.raw_content_policy: open question Q-B6 (raw output stored by hash per spec section 6)

open_questions_for_workstream_b: Q-B1: Who sets budget.token_limit - the repair consumer or the retrieval producer? Does the manifest record a budget it was given, or choose one?
Q-B2: Budget scope - are token_limit and totals.tokens evidence-only, or do they include repair prompt scaffolding (system prompt, patch instructions, delimiters)?

Q-B3: Tokenizer compatibility - tiktoken encoding must be compatible with the selected repair model (D4 condition). Which model will Workstream B select, and is cl100k_base acceptable as the estimate encoding?

Q-B4: evidence_id stability - within-run only (Workstream A brief) or deterministic across runs? The certificate/ablation engine references context nodes across runs; if cross-run stability is required, the derivation rule must change here first.
Q-B5: Transport - serialized JSON file, API response, or graph nodes? Where does Workstream B expect to read the manifest from?
Q-B6: Raw content - should the manifest carry snippet text, or references plus content hashes so Workstream B re-expands raw output by hash (spec section 6)?
